glyph.isekai_mahou.mage_mana_sense.desc: Mage technique (Frieren homage). A mana pulse spreads 24 blocks (Expand widens it): every creature with mana glows for 10 s and you see each one's mana flame — green weak, yellow, red strong, purple = boss. Tells how many presences there are and which is the strongest. Anyone under Mana Concealment stays hidden.
glyph.isekai_mahou.mage_conceal_mana.des: Mage technique (Frieren homage). Suppresses your mana for 60 s: creatures farther than 5 blocks don't notice you (hunters lose your trail) and Mana Detection can't find you. Your FIRST hit releases it all at once — spells ×1.6, blows ×1.3 — and the effect ends. Works on allies.
Mage technique (Frieren homage). A dome of mana hexagons (radius 3.5; 12 s) around the target: enemy projectiles dissolve on the wall, monsters are pushed out and blows/spells coming from outside hit the dome. Holds 135 damage (×power) before shattering. Expand/Extend increase it.
glyph.isekai_mahou.witch_broom.desc: Witch technique (Elaina homage). Conjures a broom and mounts it: it flies where you look (W/S, A/D strafes, sneak to get off) leaving a trail of petals. 90 s (Extend lengthens); Accelerate and Amplify make it faster. You float down when you get off.
glyph.isekai_mahou.witch_sleep_curse.des: Witch technique (Sleeping Beauty homage). Rose thorns and an enchanted spindle: the target sleeps for 8 s (bosses 2 s, players 3 s) — it can't move or attack and forgets its target. The first damage wakes it, at ×1.5.
glyph.isekai_mahou.witch_envy_hands.desc: Witch technique (light Witch of Envy homage). Black hands burst from the ground (radius 6) for 5 s: each grabs an enemy, drags it to the center and squeezes — 3.5 damage every 0.5 s, Corruption and Slowness IV. 6 hands; each Split adds 2.
glyph.isekai_mahou.warlock_chainsaw.desc: Warlock technique (Chainsaw Man homage). Pull the cord in your heart: chainsaws burst from your head and arms for 30 s. Melee +7, causes Bleeding and heals you for 25%; sprinting shreds whoever is in front. Once per transformation, a lethal blow leaves you standing at 30% health.
glyph.isekai_mahou.warlock_faust.desc: Warlock technique. Sign a contract with the devil (60 s): +0.4 Spell Power and ×2 mana regen, but −30% max health. Clause: defeat 3 enemies (+1 per Amplify) before the deadline. Fulfilled: full health, mana and XP. Broken: the devil takes 25% of your health, with Weakness and Slowness.
glyph.isekai_mahou.warlock_bang.desc: Warlock technique (homage to the control contract's finger gun). Point your finger and say "Bang.": half a second later the target bursts from within — 24 damage that pierces much of the armor and hurls it away.
glyph.isekai_mahou.druid_forest_god.desc: Druid LEGENDARY technique (Princess Mononoke's Forest Spirit homage). A colossal divine stag walks the area for 12 s: flowers bloom at every step; every second, allies within 9 blocks are healed and cleansed of poison, and enemies lose 7 health. With Invert it only takes life: 11 per second.
glyph.isekai_mahou.druid_sage_mode.desc: Druid technique (Naruto's Senjutsu homage). Stand STILL for 3 s absorbing natural energy (moving breaks it). Then 40 s of Sage Mode: orange pigment around the eyes, +0.35 Spell Power, +4 attack and armor, more speed and mana; you sense enemies within 20 blocks and every blow releases a wave around the target.
glyph.isekai_mahou.druid_kodama.desc: Druid technique (Princess Mononoke spirits homage). Calls 3 Kodama (Split: +1 each; max 8) for 90 s: they follow you rattling their heads, heal the most wounded ally every 3 s (double near trees) and root whoever hurts you.
glyph.isekai_mahou.necro_arise.desc: Necromancer technique (Solo Leveling homage). Raises the shadows of creatures that died nearby (up to 60 s after death) as PERMANENT Shadow Soldiers of your army (limit: 3 + Circle + 2×rank). Each shadow gets 3 tries: weak ones always rise; strong ones and bosses resist (your level and Amplify help).
Necromancer technique. Orders to the Shadow Army: on an enemy — "Attack!"; on yourself — "Come out!" (summons the army; keeping it out drains mana per second), again toggles follow/hold position; sneaking — "Return." Looking at one of your soldiers: shows its card (sneak twice to release it forever).
glyph.isekai_mahou.necro_shadow_exchange: Necromancer technique. Instantly swap places with one of your manifested soldiers — the one closest to the point hit, or (on yourself) the one you're aiming at.
glyph.isekai_mahou.necro_monarch.desc: Necromancer LEGENDARY G form (Solo Leveling homage). For 30 s (Extend: up to 60 s) the whole army comes out for free — even those still reforming —, soldiers ×1.5 stronger and tougher, the Monarch's shadow armor, Fear on enemies, effects pulse every 2 s (8 blocks) and every creature that dies within 24 blocks rises at once.
